verdict_vs_market.quote: It is a respectable offer, but not compelling for someone already happy at Meta

recommendation.quote: Negotiate. Don’t accept this offer as-is.

equity_grounding.quote: The offered guaranteed four-year value is $272,000 below your current annualized package.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: Recent crowdsourced data put Google L6 PM median base around $240,000, with reported total compensation above this offer

caveat_tenure_offering_company.quote: although those figures mix new hires with existing employees who may have stacked refresh grants.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Treat them as upside—not guaranteed offer value.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: Walk if Google stays close to the current terms and you have no strong nonfinancial reason to leave.

ask_focus.quote: Open at: $250,000 base, $1.2 million in GSUs, and a $150,000 sign-on bonus.

year1_vs_recurring.quote: So year one is actually competitive because of front-loading. The problem is the large decline in years three and four.
